simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מִפְתָּח (H4669) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מִפְתָּח (miphtâch) means an aperture , i.e. (figuratively) utterance First listed occurrence: 1Chr 9 27.

definitions.full: H4669. miphtach [ מִפְתָּח ] noun [masculine] opening, utterance ; — construct שְׂפָתַיּ מִפְתַּח Prov 8:6 i.e. that with which my lips open.
